entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - the 100% EPS beat of 8/18, whose gap faded and whose close held, specified today at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 10:23 AND CONFIRMED LIVE UNTIL 15:30 ET. AS is 34.13 bid / 34.16 ask at 14:23:16.100Z on a 0.088% spread, last trade 34.15, +1.58% against the 33.62 settled close and up 0.31 or 0.91% on the bid from the 33.82 the limit was struck against at 09:46. THE 33.87 LIMIT IS UNFILLED AND IS NOW 0.26 BELOW THE BID - it is no longer marketable and fills only if the name pulls back to it, which is the day-2 pullback entry it was written as. IT IS NOT RAISED TO 34.16 OR TO ANYTHING ELSE: widening the time to 15:30 is not permission to widen the price, and this is the fifth direction that same refusal has been tested in across two sessions. BOTH INVALIDATIONS WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME REMAIN UNTRIGGERED AND ARE FURTHER AWAY THAN THEY WERE. The earlier warning is a trade below 33.70, today's session low - the bid is 0.43 above it. The outright void is a close below 33.41, yesterday's low - 0.72 below the bid and untestable before the bell. An hourly re-reading this at 13:17 needs only the tape, those two numbers, and the 15:30 expiry.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED RATHER THAN KILLED, AND THE KILL TEST WAS APPLIED IN FULL BECAUSE ONE LIMB OF IT IS ARGUABLY MET. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limbs one and three plainly fail. Limb two is met word-for-word - 33.87 is not inside 34.13/34.16 - and the reading is decided here rather than assumed. A buy limit leaves the spread in two opposite ways. Downward, when the tape falls THROUGH it: the order would then buy above the offer, into a decline, and the level is gone - that is the case worth killing. Upward, when the tape rises above it: that is an ordinary resting bid waiting for the pullback it was always waiting for. Reading limb two to cover the upward case would kill every entry the moment its name ticked a cent through the ask, and the same rulebook forbids re-striking it - which would make the 15:30 window inoperative for exactly the case it was created for. The narrow reading is taken and written down so the retro can overrule it on the record. YESTERDAY'S PRE-CLOSE READ ITS OWN INVALIDATION WRONG AND THAT IS CORRECTED HERE BEFORE IT COULD BE INHERITED. The 8/18 record states the 33.41 warning triggered and was not repaired into the bell, measured on a 33.26 BID timestamped 19:37:21Z, twenty-three minutes before the close. The official settled close is 33.62, ABOVE 33.41. The invalidation did NOT trigger and the 32.57 outright-void level was never approached, so the thesis this board wrote in advance survived the session intact. The 8/18 retro flagged that bid-for-close substitution as eight sessions old and running in the direction that flatters this board's discipline; this is the first time it has been caught before being acted on, and had it stood, today's run would have refused a name whose own written test it had actually passed. THE OPTION ROUTE WAS PRICED AND REFUSED ON A NEW GROUND. The AS 2026-09-18 32.50 call quoted 2.55/2.60 at 13:45:01.722Z - a 1.94% spread, delta 0.672, 7,857 open interest, 260.00 a contract - clearing every option gate in docs/RULES.md outright for the first time in this board's record. 82 seconds later it quoted 2.45/2.70, a 9.71% spread, five times wider; yesterday the same strike ran 6.45% to 20.0% in four minutes. Under a 15:30 fuse a fill may be five hours from the quote the limit was reasoned on, so an unstable spread is a worse defect now than it was under the old 40-minute window. Equity quoted 0.148% at the same instant.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-print gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - ranked second today, refused on item 2, and named in advance as tomorrow's better day-2 candidate if it holds
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 10:23 AND FADING, WHICH IS THE ITEM-2 REFUSAL BEING PAID RATHER THAN REGRETTED. TGT is 158.86 bid / 159.12 ask at 14:23:17.239Z, +4.19% against the 152.48 close - DOWN 1.59 or 0.99% from the 160.45 bid this morning's open refused it at, and 1.08 below the 159.94 fifty-two-week high it set in the first fourteen minutes. Item 2 refused it for buying 9.7% off a session low at a fresh high on day 1, and an hour later the high is lower. THE WRITTEN TEST FOR TOMORROW IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT SOFTENED BY THIS: a day-2 hold above today's close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. Where today's close lands is the input that test needs and it does not exist yet.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE STRONGEST THING THIS RUN REFUSED, AND A RANKING THAT ONLY RECORDS THE WINNER IS NOT A RANKING. The mandate obliges an entry every day; it does not oblige the entry to be the loudest name on the tape. AS and TGT differ on exactly one axis - AS is on day 2 and TGT is on day 1 - and that axis is what item 2 is about. Holding both visible means the retro can grade whether the day-2 preference actually earned anything, or whether this board passed on the better trade for a rule that only sounds prudent.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, refused for a twelfth time
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON A THIRTEENTH TEST AND STILL MARKETABLE, WHICH STILL CHANGES NOTHING. SMCI is 36.46 bid / 36.48 ask at 14:23:18.295Z, a 0.055% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, -2.54% against the 37.41 close and 0.29 below the 36.75 read at the open. The 36.48 ask is 1.76 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - that order would still fill well over a dollar better than it asked, and it is not revived. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 255.22, -12.46 or -4.65%, the worst print of the thirteen-read series.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now six sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither is repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-to-8/26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone, which is still the best here, and it is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 2 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: OFF ITS LOWS AND STILL NOT A SETUP, WHICH IS THE SAME ANSWER FOR THE SAME REASON. KLAR is 14.70 bid / 14.72 ask at 14:23:09.629Z, -2.39% against the 15.06 close and 0.08 above the 14.62 the open read. A bounce inside a second consecutive down day is not a base: the precondition any entry here would need is a level struck AFTER the gap that holds on lighter volume with a written invalidation, and one hour of lift does not supply it. The day-2 argument that confirms AS today still does not transfer to a name whose day 1 was -22.5%.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND ON DAY 2 IT IS DOING THAT JOB BETTER THAN IT DID ON DAY 1. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18. AS is +0.6% today after closing +3.2%; KLAR is -2.9% today after closing -22.5%. Two beats, two sessions, opposite outcomes - which is the whole argument for requiring that a catalyst be read together with positioning rather than counted on its own.

candidatesNote: The twelve carried-forward rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:42:5x UTC and the six names added today are from a second call at 13:43:1x-13:43:2x UTC, so each row is a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. AS and TGT were RE-QUOTED at 13:46:2x when the limit was struck and both numbers are given on those rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: eleven names reported between 8/18 and this morning and all of them are priced here, including the three beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 34.06 bid at 13:42:55Z and RE-QUOTED 33.82 bid / 33.87 ask at 13:46:21Z, +0.60% against the 33.62 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares, the second consecutive not-forced entry. Reported 8/18 before the open at 0.22 EPS against 0.11, a 100% beat, verified live. This is the DAY-2 continuation the rulebook names first under setups that fit, and the objection yesterday's open raised against itself - day-1 timing - is spent. Session: opened 33.85, high 34.47, low 33.70; the entry is struck on the 0.24 pullback off the 13:42 read rather than at the high. Liquidity real: 19.71B cap, 5.24M thirty-day average, 452,739 shares in thirteen minutes, 0.148% spread. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared EVERY option gate at 13:45:01Z on a 1.94% spread with 0.672 delta and 7,857 OI, then quoted 9.71% at 13:46:23Z - refused on that instability, which is why the instrument is equity.

159.44 bid at 13:43:21Z and 160.45 at 13:46:23Z, +5.23% on a 2.46 against 2.25 beat this morning. Opened 148.285 BELOW the 152.48 close and reversed to a 159.94 fifty-two-week high on 2.16M shares against a 4.28M two-week average. RANKED SECOND AND REFUSED ON ITEM 2 - buying here is buying 9.7% off a session low fourteen minutes old, at a new high, on day 1. Named in advance as the better day-2 candidate tomorrow if it holds this close on lighter volume.

97.59 bid, +15.81% on a 0.39 against 0.32 beat. THE +8% DAY item 2 exists to refuse, and by a factor of two. Opened 93.97 and has not traded below it. Not a candidate at any price today; a day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests is the only shape that could ever qualify.

148.73 bid, -1.40% on a 1.22 against 1.19 BEAT. One of three names today that beat and sold off, and part of the live evidence item 5 passed on for AS: crowded expectations mean a merely-good report sells off. Not bought - buying the down half of a print is not a setup here.

373.44 bid, -0.85% on a 3.45 against 3.34 BEAT. Second of today's three sold beats. Also refused mechanically before any view is formed: one share is 37.0% of the account, so a single share is nearly the whole 40% single-name ceiling and there is no room to be wrong about size.
332.36 bid, -2.53% on a 3.07 against 2.42 beat - a 27% beat sold off the next morning, the sharpest of today's three and the cleanest single illustration of item 5 on the board. Not bought.

36.75 bid, -1.76%, and 1.49 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17. Twelfth test, still marketable, still not revived: a lower price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is six sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/19-8/26 calendar. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread.

14.62 bid, -2.92%, a second consecutive down day after an EPS beat of 0.01 against -0.06. No base has formed, which is the precondition any entry here would need. Kept as the counterexample to today's own thesis: two 8/18 beats, and on day 2 one is +0.6% and the other is -2.9% on top of -22.5%.

160.64 bid, +4.91% on a 1.57 against 1.44 beat after yesterday's close. Ranked third. Refused on the same item 2 ground as TGT: an after-hours print reacting the next morning is effectively day 1, and this is the first session's move.

92.83 bid, +2.16% - bouncing after an 8.66% drop on a 1.06 against 1.35 EPS MISS. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name, and a day-2 bounce off a miss is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys. The setup requires the print to have been GOOD.

29.97 bid, +2.95%, back at the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance - reclaimed from below rather than defended. Eleven sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead, so item 1 refuses it regardless of the level. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead.

76.09 bid, +2.18% on a 2.31 against 2.04 beat this morning. A real beat with a modest reaction, which is the least objectionable of today's fresh prints after TGT. Passed over for AS on the day-1 versus day-2 axis alone, and noted so the ranking is legible.
43.16 bid, -2.18%. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.
17.25 bid, -2.60%. Nine sessions past its print, nothing dated ahead, and part of the quantum complex that unwound together on 8/17 - the correlation the 2026-08-10 rule was written about.
6.94 bid, -0.72%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. Item 1 refuses it on the same ground as the rest of the carried-forward board.
40.82 bid, -1.31%. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.65 bid, +0.12%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.
